items.description:

First observed in June 2026, the financially motivated operation combines data theft, file encryption, and public leak threats to pressure organizations into paying. The group’s published […]

ttps.justification: Technique applies because: data theft. The Exfiltration Over C2 Channel technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Exfiltration phase behavior (analyst inference from advisory text).
ttps.observed_behavior: NOT OBSERVED. Hypothesis from the vulnerability description: exploiting 'New Dark Project Ransomware Group Offers Hackers 80% Commission to Expand Cybera' could enable Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (T1041) in the Exfiltration phase. No adversary use of this technique is reported by the source.
ttps.detection_hint: Alert on large data transfers (>100MB) to external IPs not in allowlist. Monitor for outbound connections on non-standard ports. Alert on data staging in temp directories.
ttps.kql_example: DeviceNetworkEvents | where ActionType == 'ConnectionSuccess' | where RemoteIPType == 'Public' | summarize BytesSent=sum(SentBytes) by DeviceName, RemoteIP, bin(Timestamp, 1h) | where BytesSent > 104857600
